arms.items: the same pack, first item only

lead.source: questions retrieval served a single rule, on this artefact

verdicts.claim: the arm is a truncation of the pack and nothing else: one item, on the split, over more than one database
verdicts.observed: 1 item(s) at most and 1.00 on average; 73.9% of prompts differ from the pair, over 11 databases and 1534 questions

verdicts.claim: the reading reproduces the lane's own contrast for the same pair, so the two implementations are one instrument
the one-rule pack does not clear the hurdle, and does not exchange better than the pair it was cut from
verdicts.observed: 0.672 clearance on a hurdle of 1.335, against 0.737 for the pair; repair +7.91pp and break +6.61pp against +9.13pp and +6.96pp

verdicts.claim: the second item is the one that pays: truncating removes more repairs than breaks
verdicts.observed: 23 repairs carried and 27 breaks caused, 0.85 repairs per break; it also prevents 15 repairs and 24 breaks, for a net -5 questions

verdicts.claim: the null replicates on a fresh store: the truncation stays below +2pp
verdicts.observed: no replication yet; the threshold this will be read against is +2pp

gates.criterion: the arm is a truncation of the pack rather than a duplicate of it: one item at most, every question asked, and the block changed on at least seven tenths of them
gates.actual: 1 item(s) at most (gate), 1534 questions read and 0 skipped, 73.9% of prompts changed

gates.criterion: the reading agrees with the lane’s own entry for the same pair to within a hundredth of a point, on the point estimate and on both discordant counts

statements.headline: assigning one rule to every question reads -0.33pp [-1.65pp, +1.25pp] against the pack retrieval returned, while the questions retrieval happened to serve one rule read +3.13pp [+0.87pp, +5.23pp] — the contrast is a property of the questions, not of the count
statements.profit: the one-rule pack clears 0.672 of its hurdle against 0.737 for the pair, so truncation moves the arm further from paying rather than closer
statements.marginal: the second item carries 23 repairs and causes 27 breaks, 0.85 repairs per break, while preventing 15 repairs and 24 breaks: a net -5 questions
statements.leverage: the arm is a strict truncation (73.9% of prompts changed, 1 item at most), so the comparison is one field of the prompt and not a second retrieval
statements.replication: no replication on disk yet: 2pp is the threshold the second store draw will be read against
